newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends ranged on high dlr liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends ranged on high dlr liquidity.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed barely moved in range-bound trade on Wednesday, due to the market being well supplied with dollars, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 58.50 to the dollar, after opening at 58.49.
"There was a little demand for dollars. But since the market is well offered, it made no impact," said a Standard Chartered Bank dealer.

Dealers say the dollar-rupee exchange rate will be ranged until there is a substantial import bill, as the market is well supplied with the greenback due to heavy net inflows through the Colombo Stock Exchange.
Overnight call money rates closed at 9.5 percent.
